question: Which style of singing is traditionally performed by men with tenpura and pakhawaj as instrumental accompaniments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhrupad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Dhrupad Style of Singing is traditionally performed by men with** tanpura and Pakhawaj **as instrumental accompaniment.
 
• Dhrupad is a style **historical style of singing, traditionally **performed by **male singers.**
 
• Dhrupad is a genre in **Hindustani classical music from the Indian subcontinent****.**

• The **thumri **is other **North Indian expressed form** and is based on the **romantic-devotional writing** inspired by the **bhakti movement.**
 
• The text is usually derived from the **Radha-Krishna theme **and is of primary importance.
